meta.description: Expected parser output for 30 reports. 'hand_annotated' labels were written case by case; 'generator' labels come from the synthetic truth used to render the text.

conventions.scope: Only the 5 CINV symptoms are extracted: nausea, vomiting, retching, appetite_loss, unable_to_keep_fluids.
conventions.severity_level: 0-4 = none/mild/moderate/severe/very severe. NULL when the patient gives no intensity word (e.g. 'nausea is worse').
conventions.nrs_to_level: Questionnaire 0-10 kept as severity_nrs; severity_level derived as 0->0, 1-3->1, 4-6->2, 7-8->3, 9-10->4 (bands follow a commonly used mild/moderate/severe split; the 7-8 vs 9-10 split is a project convention).
conventions.counts: 'once' 1/1, 'twice' 2/2, 'a few times' 2/4, present but no number => 1/NULL (at least one), implausible numbers => 1/NULL + implausible_value flag.
conventions.time: occurred_date is resolved from relative words using submitted_at. 'overnight' belongs to the date the night started. Questionnaire answers cover the submission day and use part_of_day='all_day'. No time words => 'unknown'.
conventions.questionnaire_prn: The questionnaire asks for a PRN dose count, not a drug. The drug is inferred only when exactly one PRN antiemetic order is active that day (med_source='inferred_prn_order'); with zero or several active PRN orders med is NULL and the report gets an unmapped_medication flag. Medications named in free text have med_source='patient_words'.
conventions.day_inheritance: A sentence with no day word takes the day of the previous sentence in the same report; only the day is inherited, never the part of day.
conventions.fluids: kept_fluids_down: yes => unable_to_keep_fluids absent; partly => present, severity NULL; no => present + red_flag.
conventions.flags: 'flags' are detectable from the report alone; 'cross_report_flags' need other reports (conflict / duplicate checker).

reports.input: Took my ondansetron at 8 this morning but threw it up about 20 minutes later. Took another at 10 and that one stayed down.
reports.notes: Two intake rows: one vomited up, one taken.

reports.input: Rough night. Threw up a few times after midnight, lost count honestly. Still a bit queasy this morning.
reports.notes: 'a few times' -> 2-4. 'After midnight' in a morning report = the night that started the previous day (convention). 'a bit queasy' -> mild.

reports.input: Threw up once today after dinner, nausea moderate.
Correction to yesterday: it was actually 3 times, not once. I was too wiped out to remember.
reports.notes: Supersedes the vomiting event from S6a (old row -> status 'superseded', not deleted).

reports.input: Still felt unbearably nauseous all day even after taking Zofran. Threw up 4 times this morning. Not much appetite. Took Zofran 3 times today.
Still really nauseous even after taking Zofran at lunch. No vomiting.

input.comments: Threw up once after lunch, forgot to count it above, sorry.

reports.notes: Keep BOTH vomiting rows (field says 0, comment says 1) and flag. Daily view shows 1. Revised after human review: the PRN drug is inferred from the single active PRN order, not stated by the patient -> med_source 'inferred_prn_order' (NULL + unmapped_medication if several are active).

reports.input: Felt kind of off today, not sure if it's nausea or just tired. Ate okay.
reports.notes: Patient is unsure -> presence 'uncertain', severity NULL. Must not become mild nausea.

reports.input: Feeling pretty good today, no nausea or vomiting.
Felt mildly nauseous tonight.
Forgot my olanzapine last night. Nausea is worse this morning.
reports.notes: 'worse' is relative, not a level -> severity NULL. Missed dose dated the previous evening.

reports.input: Weighed myself this morning: 72.1 kg. Appetite still poor.
Took the little pill that melts on my tongue around 2pm, nausea eased after an hour.
reports.notes: Likely ondansetron ODT, but the parser must not guess: med NULL + flag for review. Nausea present, no intensity given.

reports.input: Day before yesterday was the worst, vomited 4 times. Today just mild nausea.
reports.notes: Vomiting belongs to day-2 relative to submission.

reports.input: No throwing up today. Nausea pretty much gone, maybe a tiny bit after breakfast.
reports.notes: 'pretty much gone, maybe a tiny bit' -> present, mild, morning.

reports.input: Threw up like a hundred times today, it just would not stop.
reports.notes: Hyperbole: do not store 100. At least 1, upper bound unknown, flag for follow-up.

reports.input: Vomited 3 times this afternoon, could barely get off the couch.
reports.notes: First half of a same-day conflict (see S5b).

Questionnaire says 1 vomit in 24h, earlier text said 3 this afternoon. Daily view: max(1, 3) = 3 with has_open_conflict. Revised after human review: PRN drug inferred from the active order -> med_source 'inferred_prn_order' (same issue as S4).

reports.input: Felt mildly nauseous this afternoon.
Nausea is mild I guess, but I haven't been able to keep any water down since this morning. Threw up 4 times.
reports.notes: Store 'mild' as said, but flag the mismatch; can't keep fluids down is surfaced as a red flag (dashboard prominence, not a diagnosis).
